title: Restore desktop updates with signed update packages
summary: This release candidate embeds the desktop update verification key and publishes Tauri-signed update packages. It does not include Apple Developer ID signing, macOS notarization or Windows publisher signing; operating systems may warn or block installation. Clients missing the update key need one manual overwrite upgrade.
items: Added an explicit updater-signed publication mode that requires update keys and verifies every package signature without requiring Apple or Windows distribution certificates. Fully signed publication remains a separate strict mode.

Added a desktop-only manual recovery prompt, gated on verified published installers. Later, close and Escape suppress reminders for the local calendar day; Settings keeps the repair download available.
Repair downloads use a same-origin redirect compatible with historical native clients and stop redirecting when the publication configuration is withdrawn.
Desktop sign-in callbacks are deduplicated before one-time token redemption. Local computer execution remains available on macOS only.
